sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) FROM client c JOIN disp d ON d.client_id = c.client_id JOIN account a ON a.account_id = d.account_id JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id WHERE c.gender = 'M' AND strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) BETWEEN '1974' AND '1976' AND t.k_symbol = 'SIPO' AND t.amount > 4000
